meta.heading: Round 14: boards, full screen and the Archive
meta.intro: Step 5 is built: step into a project, a meeting series, the Daily notes, a folder or the Archive, full screen. One question about links.

r14-built5.title: Built: step 5, boards full screen, and the Archive
body: **Getting in.** Press **Boards** on the Desk's bottom bar, choose **Open full screen** on a project's box, or press **⤢** on an open drawer. **Esc** or **✕** goes back to the Desk.

**Finding your way.** The tree on the left lists every board: **Projects** (one per project), **Meetings** (one per meeting series), **Daily notes**, each of your folders, and the **Archive** at the bottom. The trail on top walks back up, e.g. Desk › Projects › Network refresh. A project's board takes on its colour.

**Three views of the same board.** **Notebook** lists its notes with one open to write in; it saves as you type. **New note** makes a page for a project, **Today's note** for Daily notes, and **Today's meeting note** for a meeting series. A project also shows its hours logged in all, its tickets still open and its latest entries and tickets; click one to open its notepad. **Board** is the board's own canvas: arrange the cards there and they keep those spots, apart from the Desk. **List** shows the boards inside, then everything on it.
**Links in notes.** Any web address in a note shows under it with a **Copy** button.

**The Archive** lists archived notes, each with **Bring back** (and Undo), and archived projects as boards. Daily notes now go to the Archive by themselves after 2 weeks without a change. Meeting series boards hold the notes titled "Weekly ops · Mon 12 Oct 2026", the ones Open note makes from the bell.

figures.caption: Boards: every board in the tree and the list.
A project's Notebook: its notes, the open note with its link and Copy, and its hours and tickets on the right.
The same project as a Board: its own canvas, tinted in its colour.
A meeting series: its notes, with Today's meeting note.
